items.title: George "Tex" Stephens Interview, 1995-08-29
items.q: Ivan and I made a bet... Ivan told me, he said, look, man, I can do you any good.

ctx.x: Okay. Reel number two at Tex Stevens, August the 29th, 1995. We're still at Tulane. So you're continuing that story on you. You got the fish in your… Yeah. And you were going to the hospital and you met your brother-in-law.

Right. Ivan Caldwell is his name, the late Ivan Caldwell. He was married to my sister-in-law, Rita. Well, incidentally, while I was in the hospital, I'm two degrees, I think, from death, so the doctor said. And I was just about going out of my head. Well, as I was slowly getting a little better, I had a lot of girlfriends come into the hospital to check me out because I was a single guy back in 1954. All right. So my current wife, who was Ivan Caldwell's sister-in-law at the time, she came up and I checked her…
